description: Server-side requests should not be vulnerable to traversing attacks
HTTP request redirections should not be open to forging attacks
Avoid allowing credentials with a wildcard Cross-Origin Resource Sharing origin
Avoid disabling TLS certificate or host name validation
Avoid using weak TLS protocol versions
Avoid forwarding authorization headers across redirects
Avoid creating cookies without the secure and httpOnly flags
Avoid disabling TLS validation on the authentication provider client
Avoid accepting JSON Web Tokens without verification
Avoid authenticating requests without authorizing them
Avoid accepting credentials over a listener without TLS
Caller redirections should not be open to forging attacks
Avoid accepting request bodies of unlimited size
Avoid allowing shared caches to store responses that require authentication
Avoid disclosing the server product version in the server response header
Avoid serving authenticated responses from a cache without revalidation
Avoid sharing a client response cache across callers when credentials are configured
